method.actual_usage: Only turn.completed provider usage is actual; cached input and reasoning output are subcategories.
method.edits: Events record changed paths, not edit tool arguments. The final patch proxy cannot reconstruct all generated edits.
method.execution: Offline analysis only; saved commands are never executed and prior artifacts are never edited.
method.mcp_duplication: Text and structured payloads repeat equivalent data in recorded transport. Whether the host serialized both into model input is unobserved.
method.phase_classification: Exclusive deterministic command buckets; mixed search/read commands remain mixed. Tags and commands are preserved for audit.
method.proxies: UTF-8 bytes and cl100k_base counts of published path-redacted strings. These exclude unknown provider wrappers and are not model tokens or bills.
method.source_reread: Exact complete-excerpt rereads are a conservative substring match against later read/search outputs. Distinctive-line overlap is additional diagnostic evidence, not coverage proof.
method.timing: Only whole CLI, setup, final grading and end-to-end times were preserved. Tool/phase/model-wait durations cannot be reconstructed.

quality_findings.interpretation: All selected regression cases pass on fixes and detect their seeds. Both atomic-output repairs suppress failed commits, confirmed by a supplemental predefined probe. Both background repairs replace HTTP failure integration coverage with direct task checks. The paired production implementations are behaviorally equivalent; passing formal checks does not establish full correctness.

/bin/zsh -lc "env PYTHONPATH=src <PROJECT>/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from requests import Session

session = Session()
cases = []
for old_port in ('', ':80'):
    for new_port in ('', ':443'):
        cases.append((f'http://example.com{old_port}/foo', f'https://example.com{new_port}/bar', False))
        cases.append((f'https://example.com{new_port}/foo', f'http://example.com{old_port}/bar', True))
for scheme, wrong_port in (('http', 443), ('https', 80)):
    for port in (wrong_port, 0, 8080, 8443):
        implicit = f'{scheme}://example.com/foo'
        explicit = f'{scheme}://example.com:{port}/bar'
        cases.extend(((implicit, explicit, True), (explicit, implicit, True)))
for scheme, port in (('http', 80), ('https', 443)):
    cases.extend((
        (f'{scheme}://example.com/foo', f'{scheme}://other.example.com:{port}/bar', True),
        (f'{scheme}://example.com:{port}/foo', f'{scheme}://other.example.com/bar', True),
        (f'{scheme}://example.com:8080/foo', f'{scheme}://example.com:8443/bar', True),
        (f'{scheme}://example.com:8080/foo', f'{scheme}://example.com:8080/bar', False),
    ))
for old_url, new_url, expected in cases:
    actual = session.should_strip_auth(old_url, new_url)
    assert actual is expected, (old_url, new_url, expected, actual)
print(f'{len(cases)} redirect security cases passed')
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONPATH=src <PROJECT>/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from itertools import product

import requests

session = requests.Session()
session.trust_env = False
cases = []
for http_port, https_port in product((\"\", \":80\"), (\"\", \":443\")):
    http_url = f\"http://example.com{http_port}/foo\"
    https_url = f\"https://example.com{https_port}/bar\"
    cases.append((http_url, https_url, True))
    cases.append((https_url, http_url, False))
for old_url, new_url in (
    (\"http://example.com/foo\", \"http://example.com:8080/bar\"),
    (\"http://example.com:8080/foo\", \"http://example.com/bar\"),
    (\"https://example.com/foo\", \"https://example.com:8443/bar\"),
    (\"https://example.com:8443/foo\", \"https://example.com/bar\"),
    (\"http://example.com:80/foo\", \"http://example.com:443/bar\"),
    (\"https://example.com:443/foo\", \"https://example.com:80/bar\"),
    (\"http://example.com/foo\", \"http://another.example.com:80/bar\"),
    (\"https://example.com:443/foo\", \"https://another.example.com/bar\"),
):
    cases.append((old_url, new_url, False))
for old_url, new_url, retained in cases:
    original = requests.Request(
        \"GET\", old_url, headers={\"Authorization\": \"Bearer token\"}
    ).prepare()
    redirected = original.copy()
    redirected.prepare_url(new_url, None)
    response = requests.Response()
    response.request = original
    session.rebuild_auth(redirected, response)
    assert (\"Authorization\" in redirected.headers) == retained, (old_url, new_url)
print(f\"{len(cases)} offline redirect authentication boundary checks passed\")
PY"
